effect_description_eng:
[Main] By trashing 1 card with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[End of All Turns] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・By deleting 1 of your [Millenniummon], you may play 1 [Wicked God] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
